The following test fixtures in this folder are copied from Core Framework
(https://github.com/CoreBunch/Core-Framework, commit 9e7390a2959fe73c62dcb39107f4b4158e7daab5):

- core-framework-css-1.1.0-default.min.css: the official CSS 1.1.0 with the default preset;
- core-framework-default-preset-1.1.0.json: the full preset GET_DEFAULT_PRESET_1_1_0;
- core-framework-default-preset.json: a reduced sample of DEFAULT_PRESET and DEFAULT_PREFERENCES.

They are test fixtures only and are not part of the desktop application. Core Framework is distributed under the
